units.source_text: 女人的身子僵硬了，无言以对。

en.t: The woman's body stiffened, and she had no words in reply.

units.source_text: 女人撑着的伞下，男人像受人催促似的，不作声地草草扒完了饭。

en.t: Under the umbrella the woman was holding, the man, as if someone were hurrying him along, silently gulped down the rest of his meal.

units.source_text: 伞的表面已积起一层沙，用手指都能在上面写出字来。

en.t: A layer of sand had already gathered on the surface of the umbrella, thick enough that one could write on it with a finger.
